name: Satarre
traits: Unbound Satarre are Medium, walk 30 ft., and have darkvision to 60 ft. Constitution +2 and Wisdom +1.
Keeper of Secrets grants Arcana proficiency, advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks about planes or planar travel, and proficiency in History, Insight, or Religion.

Portal Sense reveals the direction and distance to the nearest nonmagical entrance or exit while in a confined area. It grants advantage on Investigation or Perception checks to find hidden or invisible doors and magical portals.

Unraveling Touch is an action once per long rest, targeting one creature you can see within 30 ft. It makes a Constitution save against DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + proficiency bonus. On a failure it spends its action each turn repeating the save until it succeeds.
Speak, read, and write Umbral plus one of Abyssal, Infernal, or Void Speech.

name: Lamia
traits: Medium Monstrosity. Strength +2, Charisma +1, walk 30 ft., climb 20 ft., swim 20 ft., and darkvision to 60 ft.
Dangerous Beauty grants proficiency in Deception and Intimidation.
Serpent Strike gives advantage on attacks against creatures you surprised or creatures charmed by you or an ally.
Snake Body gives advantage on checks and saves against being knocked prone. Effects and equipment that require legs or feet confer no benefit.
Speak, read, and write Abyssal and Common.

name: Mushroomfolk
traits: Humanoid. Wisdom +2, walk 30 ft., and darkvision to 60 ft. Choose Acid Cap, Favored, or Morel to determine size and additional traits.
Fungoid Form grants advantage on saves against poison, resistance to poison damage, and immunity to disease. Hardy Survivor grants proficiency in Survival.
Speak, read, and write Mushroomfolk and either Common or Undercommon.

Acid Cap is Medium, adds Strength +1, and grants acid resistance and Athletics proficiency. When a melee weapon attack hits you from within 5 ft., you can react to deal acid damage equal to half your level rounded up to the attacker. Uses equal your Constitution modifier, minimum one, per long rest.

Favored is Medium, adds Charisma +1, and grants Persuasion proficiency. You know Spare the Dying and can cast Bless from level 3 once per long rest. Both use Charisma. Restful Spores add your proficiency bonus to HP recovered with Hit Dice at the end of a short rest by you and friendly creatures within 30 ft. Each beneficiary can receive that bonus once per long rest.

Morel is Small, adds Dexterity +1, walks 35 ft., and gains Stealth proficiency. After adjusting coloration for at least a minute in a setting rich in naturally occurring plants or fungi, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks there for 24 hours.
